text: In this book the Christoffel symbols of the Levi-Civita connection are expressed in terms of the metric by which formula?
choices: Γ^ρ_μν = ½ g^ρσ (∂_μ g_νσ + ∂_ν g_μσ + ∂_σ g_μν)
Γ^ρ_μν = ½ g^ρσ (∂_μ g_νσ + ∂_ν g_μσ − ∂_σ g_μν)
explanation: The book's formula is Γ^ρ_μν = ½ g^ρσ (∂_μ g_νσ + ∂_ν g_μσ − ∂_σ g_μν), with the factor ½, the inverse metric g^ρσ raising the index, and the two-plus/one-minus combination of first derivatives. Dropping the ½ (choice 0) or the inverse metric (choice 2), or making all three terms positive (choice 1), fails to give the metric-compatible, torsion-free connection. The single minus sign sits on the term whose derivative index is contracted through g^ρσ, namely −∂_σ g_μν.
